about: Experience the most surreal shooter ever made. LSD Battlefield Simulator, the mythical 12th installment in the #1 best-selling FPS franchise Tour of Honor, is finally here—remastered and unleashed after 25 years in the vault.

Originally completed in 2000 by visionary developer Takashi Fukuhara—at a whopping $1 billion over budget—this FPS-platformer hybrid was cancelled at the last second, sparking wild rumors of government suppression due to its hyper-realistic portrayal of LSD warfare.
Now, the masterpiece is back. Step into the game that was too intense for its time—and discover why it was never meant to be played.
Remote Play allows users to connect to and play games on their PlayStation®4 or PlayStation®5 using a mobile device, PC, or another PlayStation®4 or PlayStation®5.

You can download and play this content on the main PS5 console associated with your account (through the “Console Sharing and Offline Play” setting) and on any other PS5 consoles when you login with your same account.
